boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 103 fills the grid with numbered tiles — `11`, `19`, `14` across the top and a purple `10` bar on the left rail — turning every row into a counting puzzle. The left-rail stack of matching `10` tiles must drain before the wide bars can move, and the bottom purple tray counter tracks how many placements remain. The trap is the upper `19` tile: it looks urgent but must wait for the rail.
landmarks: Block Out Level 103 fills the grid with numbered tiles — `11`, `19`, `14` across the top and a purple `10` bar on the left rail — turning every row into a counting puzzle.
The left-rail stack of matching `10` tiles must drain before the wide bars can move, and the bottom purple tray counter tracks how many placements remain.
The trap is the upper `19` tile: it looks urgent but must wait for the rail.

quickTips: Clear every left-rail `10` tile before touching the lower purple `19` bar.
The upper purple `4` bar can move once the top row is gone — do not wait for the entire center cluster to clear first.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top-row light-blue `11`, `19`, and `14` tiles through the upper exits.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel the left-rail blue `10` stack from top to bottom before touching the center cluster.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Slide the upper purple `4` bar left once the top row and left rail are open.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Break up the center pink/green/yellow singles to open the middle column.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Shift the orange cross and remaining cyan `10` tiles into the side lanes.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Release the lower purple `19` bar through the bottom exit after the left rail is empty.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish the last green cluster and bottom-tray passes to close counter `6`.

failurePoints: Trying to slide the lower purple `19` bar before the left-rail `10` stack is gone.
Clearing the center orange cross too early while the top-row numbers are still blocking the upper exits.
